init_mannequin_challenge_model: create a MannequinChallengeModel instance that downloads and loads the pre-trained depth estimation model
estimate_depth_images: estimate depth maps from input images using the MannequinChallengeModel estimate_depth method
switch_model_to_train: switch the MannequinChallengeModel to training mode using the train method
switch_model_to_eval: switch the MannequinChallengeModel to evaluation mode using the eval method
save_model_state: save the MannequinChallengeModel generator network state dict to a file using the save method
